column2: On Sunday afternoons my uncle lounges on the sofa with a good book.
column3: 星期天下午，我叔叔懶洋洋地靠在沙發上看一本好書。
column4: lounge on a sofa (懶散地靠在沙發上)
column5: lounge 像 lunch 加 ounce：吃飽午餐就賴著不動

column2: The smell of fresh bread lured customers into the tiny bakery.
column3: 剛出爐麵包的香味把顧客吸引進這間小麵包店。
column5: lure 諧音「魯兒」，餌一放，魚就魯進來

column2: The magician manipulated the cards so fast that nobody saw the trick.
column3: 魔術師操弄紙牌的速度快到沒人看出把戲。
column5: mani 手 + pulate：用手去擺弄

column2: A few scratches marred the surface of the new wooden table.
column3: 幾道刮痕損壞了新木桌的表面。
column5: mar 諧音「馬」：馬一腳踩過去，漂亮的草地就毀了

column2: The home team massacred their rivals, winning the game by thirty points.
column3: 主隊徹底擊潰對手，以三十分之差贏得比賽。
column5: 這裡是比賽中的慘敗，把 mass 一大群想成壓倒性的比分

column2: Every morning she meditates quietly for ten minutes before school.
column3: 她每天早上上學前都會安靜地沈思十分鐘。
column4: meditate on a question (思考一個問題)
column5: medi 中間：讓心回到平靜的中間

column2: Swallows migrate south every autumn to find warmer weather.
column3: 燕子每年秋天遷徙到南方尋找較暖的天氣。
column4: birds migrate south (鳥類往南遷徙)
column5: mi 諧音「米」，鳥為了找米吃飛去別處

column2: We should minimize waste by bringing our own bottles and bags.
column3: 我們應該自備瓶子和袋子，把浪費減到最少。
column4: minimize the risk (將風險降到最低)
column5: mini 迷你 + ize 使：使變迷你

column2: The mayor mobilized hundreds of volunteers to clean up after the flood.
column3: 市長動員數百名志工在水災後清理環境。
column5: mobile 能動的 + ize：讓大家動起來

column2: The potter molded the soft clay into a round bowl.
column3: 陶藝家把軟黏土塑成一個圓碗。
column5: mold 像模具：把軟東西壓進模子成形

column2: Grandpa narrates the old folk tales in a slow, gentle voice.
column3: 爺爺用緩慢溫和的聲音講述古老的民間故事。
column5: narr 述說，narrator 就是旁白者

column2: Plenty of sleep and fresh vegetables nourish growing teenagers.
column3: 充足的睡眠和新鮮蔬菜能滋養成長中的青少年。
column5: nour 像 nurse 護士：護士照顧讓人長壯

column2: Good teachers nurture curiosity in young children with patience and praise.
column3: 好老師用耐心和稱讚培養幼童的好奇心。
column5: nurture 看到 nurse：像護士一樣照顧，慢慢養大

column2: The heavy rain obliged us to cancel the picnic.
column3: 大雨迫使我們取消野餐。
column5: ob 向 + lig 綁：被綁住，不做不行

column2: Tea originated in southwest China thousands of years ago.
column3: 茶起源於數千年前的中國西南部。
column5: origin 起源 + ate 動詞：從起點出發

column2: The school outfitted every team member with a bright new uniform.
column3: 學校為每位隊員配發一套鮮豔的新制服。
column5: outfit 衣著裝備：從頭到腳準備好

column2: The city outlawed fireworks near the forest to prevent fires.
column3: 為預防火災，市府禁止在森林附近放煙火。
column5: out 外 + law 法律：放到法律外，不准做

column2: Girls outnumber boys two to one in our school choir.
column3: 我們學校合唱團的女生人數是男生的兩倍。
column4: outnumber the enemy (人數勝過敵方)
column5: out 超過 + number 數量：數字比對方大

column2: The cruel treatment of the stray dogs outraged the whole neighborhood.
column3: 對流浪狗的殘忍對待激怒了整個社區。
column5: out 超出 + rage 憤怒：怒氣衝出來

column2: Our lunch breaks overlap, so we can eat together on Fridays.
column3: 我們的午休時間有部分重疊，所以星期五可以一起吃飯。
column5: over 在上面 + lap 部分覆蓋：蓋在上面

column2: A strong wave overturned the small fishing boat near the dock.
column3: 一道大浪在碼頭附近把小漁船打翻。
column5: over 翻過 + turn 轉：整個轉過來

column2: The fear of failing paralyzed him, and he could not speak on stage.
column3: 對失敗的恐懼使他動彈不得，在台上說不出話。
column5: para 旁邊 + lyze 鬆開：身體鬆垮不能動

column2: Street sellers peddle cold drinks and fruit to tourists along the beach.
column3: 小販沿著海灘向遊客兜售冷飲和水果。
column5: ped 腳：用腳走街串巷叫賣

column2: The city will phase out gasoline buses over the next five years.
column3: 市府將在未來五年內分階段淘汰汽油公車。
column5: phase 階段，一階一階慢慢來

column2: A sharp nail pierced the tire, and the air quickly leaked out.
column3: 一根尖釘刺穿輪胎，空氣很快漏光了。
column5: pierce 諧音「皮耳死」，耳朵穿洞就是刺穿

column2: Hunters poached rare animals in the park until the rangers stopped them.
column3: 獵人在公園裡偷獵稀有動物，直到巡守員阻止他們。
column5: poach 像 pocket 口袋：偷偷放進自己口袋

column2: She pondered the question for a long time before answering.
column3: 她思考了這個問題很久才作答。
column4: ponder a question (思索一個問題)
column5: pond 池塘：望著池塘慢慢想事情

column2: Several kinds of fish populate the clear river near our village.
column3: 有好幾種魚棲息在我們村子附近的清澈河流裡。
column4: populate an area (居住於某地區)
column5: popul 人口：pop 一群人住進去

column2: The candidate postured as a friend of farmers during the campaign.
column3: 這位候選人在競選期間擺出農民之友的姿態。
column4: posture as a hero (擺出英雄姿態)
column5: posture 名詞是姿勢，當動詞是裝出某種姿態

column2: A short film precedes the main show at the theater.
column3: 劇院裡正式演出之前會先放映一部短片。
column5: pre 前 + cede 走：走在前面

column2: The author prefaced her book with a short thank-you to her readers.
column3: 作者在書前加了一段對讀者的簡短致謝。
column5: pre 前 + face 面：放在書前面的臉面

column2: The doctor prescribed rest and plenty of water for the cold.
column3: 醫生針對感冒開了休息和多喝水的處方。
column5: pre 事先 + scribe 寫：先寫好藥方

column2: The library prohibits eating and drinking near the computers.
column3: 圖書館禁止在電腦區附近飲食。
column5: pro 在前 + hibit 抓住：擋在前面不准通過

column2: Strong engines propelled the ship across the ocean at high speed.
column3: 強力引擎推動船隻高速橫越海洋。
column5: pro 向前 + pel 推：向前推

column2: The city decided to prosecute the company for dumping waste into the river.
column3: 市政府決定起訴這家公司向河裡傾倒廢棄物。
column5: pro 向前 + secute 追：一路追到法院

column2: Teasing the dog only provoked it, and it began to bark loudly.
column3: 逗那隻狗只會激怒牠，牠開始大聲吠叫。
column5: pro 向前 + voke 叫：往前叫囂挑起事端

column2: A hungry fox prowled around the farm looking for chickens at night.
column3: 一隻飢餓的狐狸夜裡在農場周圍徘徊尋找雞。
column5: prowl 諧音「泡肉」，餓了到處找肉

column2: This machine purifies water so that families can drink it safely.
column3: 這台機器淨化水質，讓家人能安心飲用。
column5: pur 純 + ify 使：使變純

column2: After the hike, a glass of cold water quenched his thirst.
column3: 健行後，一杯冰水解了他的口渴。
column5: quench 諧音「誇奇」，誇它一口喝下去，渴就解了

column2: Several parents queried the new homework rule at the school meeting.
column3: 好幾位家長在學校會議上對新的功課規定提出疑問。
column5: query 和 question 都有 qu：都是發問
